note: ADR-591 (RM-TRUTH-01 memory track, A5). Query-expansion aliases: RU/EN/superseded names for the SAME entity, OR-expanded by spa_core.studio_os.memory.index.concepts() exactly like the static GLOSSARY. `valid_to` marks a name the owner retired (ADR-554, 2026-10-04: 'Штирлиц' -> 'Oracle'); the name still matches OLD text that used it (so history stays retrievable), and `index.alias_groups()`/`concepts()` surface the supersession as `alias_note` so a caller can print 'ex-name, valid until <date>' instead of presenting the old name as current. A group with `ambiguous` is loaded but NEVER expanded (expanding it would trade a false negative for several false positives); 'Core' has three live meanings (Balanced-tier display name, the spa_core package, and 'core engine' as a colloquialism) and none of them was obviously the most common one to force.

groups.ambiguous: 3 live meanings: the Balanced-tier display name, the spa_core package, and 'core engine' as a colloquialism — do not auto-expand
